# Solusite Media

> Independent web design studio in Pretoria, South Africa. Fixed-price websites for service businesses — built before you pay, delivered in days.

Solusite Media is a one-person studio run by Ian Spies. We build complete working website demos for South African service businesses (architects, attorneys, B&Bs, driving schools, photographers, interior designers) before any money changes hands. Pricing is a flat R5,000 build plus R700/month for hosting, SEO, edits and support.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, recent work, process, pricing, and contact.
- [Refer & Earn](/referral): Referral programme — R1,500 cash for every referred business that signs up.
